entries.currentBehavior: 静默服务器接受连接但不完成协议；50ms timeout reject，耗时小于500ms 且 client.isConnected() 为 false。
entries.problem: generic NETWORK timeout 与 Promise.race 可能遗留独立 timer/连接；isConnected=false 不能证明 Scope 无泄漏。

pureTransitions: now >= deadline && no readiness -> HandshakeTimeout with elapsed evidence。
timeout -> disconnect/close listener; late native callbacks stale。

entries.effectBoundary: Effect Clock/timeout 提供时间，Layer owns EClient；fixture 只观察 timeout/finalizer。
entries.durability: 失败 attempt 写 health evidence；无 DispatchStarted 时无 mutation outcome，重连不读取内存 waiter。
errors: ConnectionFailure(HandshakeTimeout)，caller 获得 phase/deadline。
ResourceLeakDetected 为 defect，不能吞。
preservedBehavior: 保留 silent peer 快速 timeout 和 isConnected=false。
使用 deterministic Clock/Scope evidence 替代仅 wall-clock 阈值。
replacementSteps: 把 timeout policy 从常量移到 connection Layer config，区分 handshake/account-readiness。

entries.contractRationale: One wire shared by current-time callers remains provider resource behavior; K01/K07 add generation, cancellation, and exact output schema.

entries.problem: coalescing 正确，但 mutable singleton 未绑定 Scope/connection generation；旧连接 callback 可能完成新 probe，失败类型和 cancellation 不可见。

Existing same generation -> join waiters, no second wire request。
callback -> validate timestamp, complete live waiters, emit ProbeSucceeded。
generation mismatch -> StaleCallback, no completion。

openQuestions: Native currentTime unit/clock skew contract must be recorded; source only treats it as seconds.

entries.contractRationale: Probe retry remains, but K07 leaves native send boundary ambiguous; throw cannot prove no remote effect or authorize order retry.
sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:177-190: first reqCurrentTime send throws synchronously, Promise rejects; next call sends again and resolves from currentTime callback.

entries.contractRationale: Positive bid/ask early completion remains a caller-declared snapshot variant; K03/K05 require context, quality, units, and missingness.

quality/currency/timestamp become explicit instead of raw numeric object。
replacementSteps: Implement tick codec and EarlyCompletionPolicy in market-data interpreter。
Migrate test to QuoteObservation assertion and late tick isolation。
verificationCases: BID=2,ASK=4 before end resolves BidAskReady with quality/observedAt。
BID=0 or NaN never triggers early completion; end produces Partial/Missing typed result。

entries.contractRationale: Ordinary snapshot waits for end; K05 makes end, partiality, timeout, and cancellation a data-delivery contract.

pureTransitions: ticks before end update immutable accumulator。
tickSnapshotEnd -> decode; Result Satisfied(Complete|Partial) per required fields。
timeout -> ObservationFailure(SnapshotDeadline) with received tick summary, not zero quote。
entries.effectBoundary: Effect Deferred is completed by market-data interpreter; end marker/timeout are external events. Pure reducer handles accumulation/completion classification.
entries.durability: RemoteObservation may record end marker and sequence; query projection includes observedAt/freshness. No durable mutation.
errors: ObservationFailure(SnapshotIncomplete) when policy requires missing field。

Persist/emit completion evidence before releasing correlation; test missing/late ticks。

openQuestions: IBKR may emit end without all fields; required-field policy must be explicit caller input.
